summary: Single-file HTML and JavaScript module for WMS Thermocol Tax Invoice (Stock Transfer Note). Meets all requirements: A4 Landscape orientation, corporate blue #1e3a8a header with white text, Consignor on left / Invoice details on right, clean thin black borders, natural content-based page breaking without hardcoded limits, English-only 'To be continued...' continuation notice, summary totals and transporter details strictly on the last page, dynamic Page X of Y numbering, and working Download HTML / Download & Print PDF buttons.
